answer_2.quote: We report NDCG@5 as our primary ranking metric, which evaluates how well relevant items are ranked within the top 5 results, giving higher importance to those appearing earlier.

answer_4.quote: Annotators reviewed the query and retrieved page (labeled as negative) to determine if it could answer the query (Fig. ). A total of 234 responses from 5 annotators were collected.
answer_4.guideline: Annotators were shown the page image alongside its corresponding query and asked whether the page contained an answer to the query.
